description:
Problem
Clearing the SMTP configuration name and saving is now reachable through the form's novalidate behavior. EmailConnectorSettings.smtp_persistence_result/2 returns a ChannelConfig changeset for non-file errors, but NotificationSmtpLive renders an EmailConfig form. A review regression test proved the entered relay value disappears after rejection. The page does not crash.

Scope and acceptance
- Preserve the EmailConfig form schema, submitted SMTP credentials, connection-name draft and Advanced/file settings for persistence-level errors.
- Project actionable persistence errors into the correct form fields, select Main for a name error, and keep tab navigation usable.
- A rejected save must leave persisted configuration unchanged. Correcting the name and saving must persist the original drafts.
- Cover blank name and representative persistence errors in the existing EmailConnectorSettings and SMTP LiveView suites; include both new and existing connections where applicable.
- Keep the existing file-error projection and cross-service boundary intact.
Action reuse: extend the existing EmailConnectorSettings save operation and error projection. Reuse the existing NodeRouter/Event route; no new Action, endpoint or tool.
Read docs/services/engine.md, DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before affected work.

Implementation prompt
Work on PR 2 in ../zaq-feat-channel-file-settings, branch feat/channel-file-settings (PR jat10/zaq#16, stacked on feat/email-capabilities). Verify current Git state and preserve other work. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Use Serena for source navigation. Implement with TDD: demonstrate the failure first, make the smallest coherent fix, then run focused regressions and mix q. Reuse existing test modules, fixtures and setup; create a test module only when no suitable owner exists, explaining why. Write original tests; do not copy tests from the old worktree or weaken existing assertions. Follow existing-test approval rules. Do not run mix precommit, commit, push or merge without fresh authorization.
title: [zaq-h2i.3] Preserve SMTP form drafts on persistence validation errors
